releases.name: Quern - Undying Thoughts
releases.summary: Discover the truth about Quern’s past, unfold the mysteries of its present, and be the explorer who shapes its future. Quern introduces reusable puzzle mechanics to the classic genre, making the player think about the game as a whole, and not just as a series of individual challenges.

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape
releases.summary:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels

releases.name: Save The President
releases.summary:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

But be careful: react too soon and you could cause a national scandal. Hesitate for even a second, and the consequences could be fatal!

When a gunman’s laser sight appears in the crowd, the clock starts ticking. You’ll have only seconds to make the right move: leap heroically toward the podium, neutralize the gunman hiding in the crowd, or put yourself directly in the line of fire and take the bullet to save the President.

The future of the nation depends on your reflexes.

Save the President at any cost!

releases.name: Dream Hike
releases.summary:
Dream Hike is a relaxing walking simulator where you explore a beautiful, colorful world in search of hidden melons. Wander through forests, valleys, mountains, and mysterious paths as you discover new places and see what the world has to offer.

There’s no rush and no danger. Just put on your hiking boots, enjoy the scenery, and keep your eyes open.

How many melons can you find?

releases.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
releases.summary:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

releases.name: Funi Raccoon Game
releases.summary:
Funi Raccoon Game, a 3D Platformer Collectathon. You play as a raccoon who has recently acquired a new home (Dumpster).

Home is where the stuff is, but your home is pretty empty. Fill up your dumpster with cool, unique stuff. The more stuff you have, the more places you can go! Travel the lands, "help" the locals, and solve puzzles -- all in the aim to get more stuff!?!

releases.name: Cargo Rail Tycoon
releases.summary: Cargo Rail Tycoon is a trading and train-driving game set on the railways of Michigan. You are a freight entrepreneur with one simple goal: turn a small convoy and a modest bankroll into a rail empire. Buy goods where they are cheap, load your wagons, and haul them across the map to the towns that need them most — profit is made on the journey, not on the spot.But this isn't a game you play from a spreadsheet. Every trip puts you in the cab. You drive the train yourself: open the throttle on the straights, ease off through the curves — brake too late and you derail — and read the signs at each switch to reach the right town. Bandits may block the tracks; stop and haggle the ransom down, or pay the price. Arrive fast for a bonus, but arrive at the right destination or lose out.Between journeys you negotiate face-to-face with each town's station master. Haggle their margin down before you trade — offer low, and watch them squirm — then choose your next destination wisely and roll out again. Twenty-six towns are waiting, and the farther north you push, the bigger the rewards for those willing to travel.Turn cargo into cash, cash into a bigger convoy, and a bigger convoy into a fortune — just don't go bankrupt on the way.Key features-Trade across 26 towns — a living supply-and-demand economy where prices rise and fall. Find the routes, corner the goods, grow your cash.-Drive every train — first-person rail journeys where speed, curves, braking and route choices are all yours. Go too fast and you derail; take the wrong turn and you arrive at the wrong town.-Haggle every deal — negotiate the station master's margin down with a multi-round back-and-forth. Push too hard and he'll dig in.-Bandit roadblocks — stop and negotiate the ransom, or plough through and pay for it.-Build your convoy — buy wagons matched to your cargo and expand your train as your business grows.-A fresh route every trip — procedurally generated railways with curves, bridges, rivers and scenery, and a destination that can lie straight ahead, left or right — follow the signs.-Explore the whole map — the far-north towns pay the best prices, rewarding the boldest hauls.

releases.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
releases.summary: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

releases.name: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop
releases.summary:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune. The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

releases.name: Down Pit
releases.summary:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

releases.name: World Waifus: Spin & Snap Puzzle
releases.summary:
Ready to take a trip around the world with charming travel snapshots? This casual puzzle game brings together girlfriend-style photos of beautiful women traveling through destinations around the globe.

The rules are simple:
- Study the photo panels, each turned in a different direction
- Tap a panel to rotate it into the correct orientation
- Line everything up to complete the full photo

A great pick for fans of travel snapshots, beautiful scenery, cute characters, quick casual games, and brain-teasing puzzles.

releases.name: HENTAI Match! Asian Beauties
releases.summary:
Set in lively Asian streets and seaside scenes, this casual puzzle game invites you to complete captivating photos by rotating mixed-up panels into place.

As you progress, each image is divided into more panels, gradually increasing the challenge. If you get stuck, use one of up to three hints to align a row and get back on track.

Take your time to study each shape, or trust your instincts and make quick rotations. Enjoy glamorous photos, satisfying puzzles, and moments of discovery as you bring every image together.

releases.name: Sweet Youth! Heroine Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
Remember those school days filled with sweat, tears, and unforgettable friendships? Take a nostalgic trip through snapshots of heroines devoted to their clubs, from tennis and rock bands to archery and cheerleading.

Compare the two illustrations and find the one difference hiding on the right side.

Enjoy a bittersweet, dazzling feeling, as if you had returned to the days when you gave your all to a school club. With simple gameplay, it is easy for anyone to pick up and play.

releases.name: Kids' World History: Which Side Are You On!?
releases.summary:
Could a surprising piece of history be true - or just a myth? If you learned it in school, you might remember the basics. But world history is packed with facts that sound almost unbelievable.

This casual true-or-false quiz brings fascinating world history trivia to life in a simple, fun format. Explore stories from ancient civilizations, cultures, and remarkable people from across the ages.

Perfect for history fans, trivia lovers, families, and anyone looking for a quick brain break. Challenge yourself, compare guesses with friends, and enjoy a lively quiz whenever you have a few spare minutes.

releases.name: Family Journey: Hidden Across the World
releases.summary:
Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world!

Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks. Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together.

Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements.

Family Journey is the cozy world tour you have been waiting for. Ready to explore?

releases.name: Settlement Defense
releases.summary:
Turn a small settlement into a fortified stronghold. Collect resources, construct buildings, and strategically prepare for relentless waves of enemies.

Build, manage, and defend your settlement against relentless waves of enemies. Every successful defense begins long before the next attack arrives, so gather valuable resources, construct essential buildings, and carefully prepare your defenses.

Develop your settlement by creating structures that provide the materials you need to survive. Balance your available resources between expanding production and strengthening your defensive positions. Every decision matters as the countdown to the next enemy wave continues.

Adapt your strategy as the challenge grows. Improve your economy, expand your settlement, and create stronger defenses capable of surviving increasingly dangerous attacks. Careful planning and efficient resource management can make the difference between building a thriving stronghold and watching everything fall.

How long can your settlement survive?

releases.name: Cat Magnifier
releases.summary: JET SHOOT GAME:It's a wonderful shooting game.You will be able to shoot jet fighter with missiles and with speed.Have Fun enjoying the Action of defending against Air Strikes!!!!!

releases.name: HENTAI Puzzle: Doki Doki Dress-Up
releases.summary:
Ready for a charming outfit challenge?

Put together a colorful lineup of stylish women in eye-catching work outfits. This easygoing montage puzzle turns three sliced illustration panels into one polished look.

It is great for a quick break, casual brain training, or anyone who enjoys cute character art and short puzzle sessions. When the panels click perfectly into place, you may want to try just one more!

releases.name: Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle
releases.summary:
Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle is a casual photo puzzle featuring charming guys in refreshing water-themed scenes - from pools and beaches to waterfalls and showers.

As you advance, the photos are divided into more panels, gradually raising the challenge. If you get stuck, a hint can straighten out one uncertain row. You can use up to three hints, making it easy to enjoy even if puzzles aren’t your specialty.

Perfect for anyone who enjoys handsome, muscular guys, romantic vibes, refreshing scenes, quick casual puzzles, or testing their observation and intuition.
